title: sfp2onenote sidecar (sfp-state.json)
description: Written beside a generated notebook folder as {NotebookFolder}.sfp-state.json: the tool version, the manifest id, the quarter, the notebook's OneNote ids and a map from page key to its page id, section id and tool-owned anchor object ids. Refresh reads it to find the objects it may edit; it is rebuilt from the notebook's sfp.key metas when missing.

sections.description: Plan section name to OneNote section ID.

sectionGroups.description: Section group name (Weeks with --group-weeks) to OneNote section group ID; empty, or absent in older files, for a notebook without groups.

pages.description: Page key (cover, day:2027-01-04, week:02:overview ...) to its ids.

confirmedInked.description: Setup slot id (objective:3, standingGoal:1, metricName:2, habit:4) to the inked text a Refresh run told to write inked values wrote; while the Setup slot still reads that text, a run without the confirmation treats it as typed. Absent or empty in older files.

planOptions.description: The Generate options that shaped the notebook's plan (the options the plan builder reads), so Refresh rebuilds the plan the notebook was generated with. Absent in files written before they were recorded, which keep the defaults; a member left out keeps its default.

timeBlockWindow.description: The Time Blocks window the daily pages were generated with: first row hour and the hour after the last row, 24-hour clock. Absent in files written before it was recorded.

anchors.description: Anchor or slot id (dailyDate, calendarDay:2027-01-04, objectiveLegend ...) to the objectID of the outline the tool wrote.

anchorTexts.description: Slot id to the text Refresh last wrote in that slot's outline, so a later run can tell the user edited it; absent or empty in older files.
